hero.title: Privacy Policy.
hero.intro: This notice describes how the independent professionals operating under the «Studio Galilei» brand collect, use, store and protect personal data, including the data we access through Google APIs when we manage our partners' advertising accounts.

controllers.name: Carlo Durigon
controllers.services: Management and optimisation of advertising campaigns and traffic analysis. Responsible for data access through Google APIs: the Google Cloud project, the developer token and the Google Ads (MCC) account are registered in his name.

controllers.name: Studio Galilei Srl
controllers.vat: VAT no. and tax code IT05642810260
controllers.address: Via Francesco Baracca 81, 31035 Crocetta del Montello (TV), Italy
controllers.services: Project management, partner coordination and strategic consulting on the projects entrusted to Studio Galilei.

googleData: account and campaign structure and settings;
keywords, ads, ad groups and related assets;
purposes: Providing services for the creation, management, monitoring and optimisation of advertising campaigns on partners' accounts (performance of a contract).
Reporting and analysis of results for the partner's benefit (performance of a contract).
Responding to contact requests and pre-contractual activities (consent, pre-contractual measures).
Legal obligations and protection of rights (legal obligation, legitimate interest).
limitedUse: we use data obtained from Google APIs solely to provide and improve the campaign management and optimisation features requested by the partner;

we do not sell this data and do not transfer it to third parties, except to the extent necessary to provide the service, to comply with legal obligations or as part of a merger or acquisition, with appropriate notice;
we do not use Google API data for personalised advertising purposes;

we do not allow humans to read this data, except: with the partner's prior consent, for security purposes, to comply with legal obligations, or when the data is aggregated and anonymised and used for internal operations.

iDatiSonoTrattatiConStrumenti: Data is processed with electronic tools, adopting technical and organisational measures appropriate to guarantee its security and confidentiality. Access to Google account data normally takes place in real time through the APIs; any stored data (for example reports) is kept for the time needed for the stated purposes and legal obligations, and then deleted or anonymised.
iDatiPossonoEssereTrattatiDa: Data may be processed by Studio Galilei and by the professional collaborators operating under the same brand, who are authorised to process it and bound by confidentiality obligations, as well as by suppliers acting as data processors (hosting services, analytics and reporting tools). The up-to-date list of processors is available on request at

alcuniFornitoriTraCuiGoogle: Some suppliers (including Google) may process data outside the European Economic Area. In such cases the transfer complies with the GDPR, on the basis of appropriate safeguards such as the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
aiSensiDegliArtt1522DelGdprL: Under Articles 15–22 of the GDPR, data subjects have the right to access their data, request its rectification or erasure, restrict or object to its processing, and request its portability. They may also withdraw their consent at any time and lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali). Requests should be sent to
